## Make a report useful

Include your **router model, complete Asuswrt-Merlin version and Skynet version**, followed by the exact command or WebUI action, what happened and what you expected. For interface problems, add your browser and version.

When available, run this over SSH and include the relevant output alongside the exact error or related syslog lines:

```sh
firewall debug info
```

Review logs and screenshots before sharing them. Remove credentials and private network details; a short relevant excerpt is usually more useful than a complete log or configuration file.

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/Adamm00/IPSet_ASUS/issues) before opening a new report. If the same problem is already being discussed, add your reproduction details there.
